stemMd: Every restored facade was inspected. Some inspected facades received grants. Which conclusion must follow?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every restored facade received a grant.

options.label: C
options.textMd: No restored facade received a grant.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Every restored facade belongs to the inspected group.

explanationMd: The first premise places all restored facades within the inspected group. The grant information identifies another subset of inspected facades without fixing its overlap with restored ones. Only the stated inclusion is necessary.

distractorRationale.b: Inspection does not guarantee a grant.
distractorRationale.d: The two inspected subgroups need not overlap.
distractorRationale.c: The premises do not exclude overlap.
